system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park authenticated to the domain controller from WS-LPARK-01, and the subsequent account-creation and Temp-Staff membership events used the same logon ID.
At 13:44 UTC, lucy.park created tmp.rwong and added it to Temp-Staff. This matches the stated help-desk temporary-account workflow; the available records do not show an administrator-group addition.
Lucy Park launched OpenSSH from cmd.exe with the target PROXY-HD-01, and the workstation resolved that host and initiated a TCP connection to its SSH port 22.

The SSH activity is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01, but the records establish a connection attempt, not successful authentication or remote actions.
Edge on WS-LPARK-01 connected to PROXY-HD-01 on port 8080, consistent with the inventory identifying that host and port as the explicit web proxy.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-HD-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage; this overlaps the account creation and the observed proxy connection.
The supplied endpoint records show an outbound SSH TCP connection but do not show whether SSH authentication succeeded, what occurred in any resulting session, or whether commands were run remotely.
claims_not_established: Whether the SSH connection to PROXY-HD-01 was authorized, successfully authenticated, or used for remote administration.
Whether tmp.rwong was used after creation, or whether its creation had an approved request.
What web destinations or activity were involved in the port 8080 connection during the proxy-log outage.
Whether the observed activity was malicious or merely unauthorized, mistaken, or otherwise legitimate.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-HD-01 SSH authentication, session, and command logs for the period, including any available host-side audit records.
Proxy logs or other network records covering 13:30–14:10 UTC to determine the activity associated with the port 8080 connection.
The help-desk request or ticket authorizing tmp.rwong, and directory audit data showing the account's group memberships and subsequent use.
Relevant endpoint and domain-controller records to determine whether Lucy Park or tmp.rwong performed further actions after the events shown.
